restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes (one root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0).
Grouped birthday: 2^96 groups; shared m0..m14; enumerate all m15.

Retained prefixes[g] table stores packed m0..m14 (two 256-bit words) per group; written at group setup; read on VERIFY. Live BT record recs[s]=(g||m15) reconstructs the 64-byte message via prefixes[g] — repairs 7212 EVAL-F1/F-MSG-RECONSTRUCTION.

K_full is the full 256-bit partial-eval digest. Briggs-Torczon sparse set indexes by top 140 bits; sparse entries are 256-bit words; never clears sparse[]; membership via dense[sparse[idx]]==idx and sparse[idx]<n.
Unequal-K index hits discard with Word ops only (no target compression). Equal K_full triggers VERIFY (§2.5): rebuild both messages via prefix table, then two reference compressions; V_max=8.

Per-message Word ops = 290 = 252 inner + 14 pack + 24 BT/K-compare/counter; outer unroll 3/256 in T. The 24-op H-COST-BT-SPARSE envelope includes the live (g||m15) counter update (documented margin reallocation from prior separate +1). Group setup <=512 Word/group => <2^97 units. VERIFY Word work <=640 => <2 units. T_ver compressions <=16. No expectations in T.

Declared score-critical heuristics: H1-grouped-digests (probability only); H-COST-BT-SPARSE (24-op BT+counter envelope); H-COST-PARTIAL-EVAL (252-op inner body, organizer Word accounting, segment-metered).
F2 is earliest-completing colliding-pair displacement (Pr<=2^-12 under H1), with pair selection defined in proof §4.

Undercut of 9551ae18 (291→290) by absorbing the mandatory m15 counter update into the existing 24-op BT envelope (edge-margin reallocation; BT stays at defendable 24). Does NOT shrink BT below 24, does NOT revive c367 H-COST-SPARSE-21, does NOT claim pack=0, does NOT use public 247 _g undercount. Adds partial-eval metering evidence for F-COST-PARTIAL-COUNT-EVIDENCE. Retains c145/4dd/c367-BT/7212 repairs. Unkeyed BLAKE3-256; 2 rounds.

heuristics.statement: For uniformly random independent group prefixes and exhaustive m15 enumeration, the 2^128 digests behave like independent uniform 256-bit strings for bounding F1, the earliest-completing-pair F2 displacement probability conditional on existence of a collision, and F4, up to a negligible additive gap covered by the allowance between the model bound (>0.3932) and claimed success probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Success-probability claim only. Does not justify expectation-for-worst-case substitutions in the time bound. Includes the F2 conditioning claim that earliest-completing-pair selection does not inflate the N/2^140 occupancy bound under this independent-uniform model.
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer matched-scale digest-xor-mask experiments at widths 16, 20, and 24 with N_t^2/2^w=1, plus single-group stress, are consistency checks only. They do not rigorously establish full-scale 256-bit iid behavior over 2^128 structured messages; that step remains the modeling content of this heuristic.
heuristics.limitations: H1 unproved. Truncation cannot detect almost-permutations. No full-scale collision known. Experiments expressly do not support iid success-probability or full-scale inference (CRYPT-H1 / EXP-EXT gaps acknowledged).

heuristics.statement: On the classical 256-bit word RAM of collision-frontier-v5, the Briggs-Torczon procedure in proof §2.4 together with the mandatory live (g||m15) counter update implements membership test (dense[sparse[idx]]==idx and sparse[idx]<n), insert of (idx,K_full,g||m15), unequal-K discard, and counter increment for a top-140-bit index with never-cleared sparse[] of 256-bit words in at most 24 charged primitive word operations per message, including one 256-bit K_full compare and address-arithmetic margin. Message reconstruction is out of scope for this heuristic (it uses the prefixes table in VERIFY, charged separately).
heuristics.scope: Only the 24-op BT+counter envelope inside the 290-ops/msg candidate ledger. Does not cover partial-eval inner body, pack, group-setup prefix writes, VERIFY reconstruction Word ops, or reference compressions. Envelope remains 24 (same defendable floor as c1a7e1b9 / 9551ae18); the prior separate +1 loop line is absorbed into documented edge margin, not a trim below 24.
heuristics.extrapolation: Standard Briggs-Torczon correctness (dense[sparse[i]]==i filter) extrapolated to word-addressable sparse[0..2^140) without an initialization pass. Analytic from the §2.4 op list and path table; no empirical RAM microbenchmark.
heuristics.limitations: Not empirically microbenchmarked. If word-addressing a 2^140 sparse table required multi-op page walks beyond the 24-op margin, the ledger would need a higher BT charge (fallback: restore 28-op / 297 / 127.467 via 03e49dc5).

heuristics.statement: On the classical 256-bit word RAM with the organizer Word-accounting convention of scripts/reference_operation_costs.py (each +,&,|,^,<<,>> counts 1; _ror expanded as shift+shift+OR+mask; no native 32-bit rotate), the grouped m15 partial-evaluation body in proof §2.3 / §2.6 computes the eight 32-bit digest lanes of a 2-round BLAKE3 root compression in exactly 252 charged primitive word operations per message when feed-forward is 8 xors with no trailing & MASK. Segment identity: r1_finish=15, r2_col0_full=30, r2_col1_partial=22, r2_col2_partial=27, r2_col3_full=30, r2_diagonals=120, ff=8. Full organizer _g meters at 30 (not the public 29). Digests are bit-identical to verifier/blake3.py.
heuristics.scope: Only the 252-op inner partial-eval line of the 290-ops/msg ledger. Does not cover pack, BT, loop/counter, group setup, or VERIFY. Does not justify expectation substitutions in T.
heuristics.extrapolation: Word-meter counts on the exact §2.3 programme are identity checks against the organizer accounting that sets C=blake3-r2=430 for a full compress. Segment counts are deterministic for every message; no sampling extrapolation. Correctness vs verifier/blake3.py is checked on every metered trial in experiment b3r2-partial-eval-meter.
heuristics.limitations: Observation op counts emitted by python-message-pairs programmes are labeled untrusted by the harness; the adjudicated content is the analytic segment ledger plus the readable meter source. If a reviewer requires trailing FF & MASK, restore ff=16 → inner 260 → dominant 298 → time_log2 127.472 (still above BT-24 floor; not this package).
